entities.name: Sharuum
entities.description: A female sphinx and Hegemon of Esper on Alara, its de facto philosopher queen.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: Shard of Alara ruled by Sharuum.

entities.name: Crucius
entities.description: Sharuum's lover who introduced etherium to the plane and disappeared.

entities.name: Malfegor
entities.description: Led a march against the shards during the Conflux.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: Event during which many Esper leaders were slain.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Planeswalker who convinced Sharuum that Crucius was alive.

events.summary: After Crucius disappeared, Sharuum devoted much of her life to finding him.
events.quote: After Crucius disappeared, Sharuum devoted much of her life to finding the whereabouts of her former partner.

events.summary: During the Conflux many Esper leaders were slain; Sharuum fled and secluded herself.
events.quote: she fled and secluded herself to prepare more stringent defenses

events.summary: Tezzeret convinced Sharuum that Crucius lived; she traded him her possessions, power and throne for time with him.
events.quote: He convinced her that Crucius was still alive

events.summary: On the Metal Island Sharuum's etherium was stripped; Tezzeret treated her and reunited her with Crucius, then commanded her to return and rule.
events.quote: Tezzeret quickly treated Sharuum's wounds and reunited her with Crucius.

relations.quote: Her lover, Crucius , introduced etherium to the plane.
These led him to Kemuel , Sharuum's son.
Sharuum is a female sphinx and the Hegemon of Esper
